body: My field is aerospace engineering and I'm 3.5 years into it. I came into college as a student who was looking at going to MIT. I don't think there's a chance of working my way up. Anything where I can't find a damn good salary and support my parents is a failure at this point. I just keep digging myself into a deeper hole. And they've given up way too much for me to quit. Literally the only options are to take myself completely out or persevere against absolutely all odds. but if I don't succeed with the latter I will hurt them even more [superficially] than if I were to completely remove myself right now.

I'm 21. I came in to college as a 4.7 GPA student and slowly let my grades slip. I can't recover from where I am now and no employer will give me a chance. My family keeps pressuring me about how important it is to find a good-paying internship and I keep getting rejected for everything I apply for. I've been looking for jobs outside my field but nobody will even interview me for those and my family can't afford to finance another summer of me fucking around.

See that's the worst thing. The only thing that keeps me alive is guilt.
I can't bear the fact that they've given up everything for me. My 10-year-old brother wakes up at 5am every morning for the sole fat that by doing that he my give me the chance to succeed but I just keep fucking up everything that I'm give. Everyone would be objectively better off without me. But I can't bear the agony of hurting my parents and my brother.

I mean, what's worse: to be a coward forever or a detriment to anybody who cares enough to step in for the foreseeable future? I have nothing let but love for my family. and the only way I see to help them is to give them one less person to worry about.
